preexecution_repair.when: before any R1.12 G2 geometry execution
preexecution_repair.change: LSE selection changed from first ROUX_LSE line to the maximal contiguous ROUX_LSE span after SB completion, with the last line endpoint as the LSE target.
preexecution_repair.reason: The frozen parser maps EOLR, EOLRb, EP and LSE annotations into ROUX_LSE. Selecting the first line could repeat the already-localized SB subphase/completion error. No G2 outcome had been observed when this repair was made.

population_flow: exactly one nonempty ordinary ROUX_FB annotated line (pseudo FB and FBDR forked out)
center canonicalization succeeds for every state queried by the operator
at least one two-block physical-axis completion occurs inside the SB span
the first completion state has exactly one completed physical axis
FB endpoint uniquely orients that axis because exactly one of its two blocks is solved there

denominators.sb_search_eligible: state-certified ordinary-FB routes with an SB span
denominators.sb_any_completion_rate: routes with >=1 completed physical axis at some SB-span state / sb_search_eligible
denominators.unique_axis_completion_rate: routes whose first any-completion state has exactly one completed physical axis / routes with any completion
denominators.fb_orientation_rate_given_unique_axis: routes where FB endpoint solves exactly one of that unique axis's two blocks / unique-axis routes
denominators.primary_exact_fb_attempts: fb-oriented unique-axis routes; these are the G2-admitted primary attempts
denominators.sb_completion_rate: same numerator as G2-admitted / sb_search_eligible; reported separately because it is the end-to-end SB operator success rate

phase_selection.SB: first contiguous ROUX_SB span; objective stops at first unique state-certified two-block completion
phase_selection.CMLL: first nonempty ROUX_CMLL line after SB completion; if absent, no CMLL opportunity
phase_selection.LSE: maximal contiguous ROUX_LSE span beginning at the first ROUX_LSE line after SB completion; objective target is the last line endpoint, so EOLR/EOLRb/EP subphases cannot be mistaken for completed LSE solely because they are classified ROUX_LSE
